Agent-matching services, compared honestly

Every "find an agent" service is free to you — the agent pays a referral fee. What differs: how much, who gets your number, and whether rankings can be bought.

ServiceAgent's referral feeWho contacts youHow agents are ranked
Money Move Homes25% (disclosed)Only the one agent you pickPublished score; no paid placement
HomeLight33% of the agent's commission (published)Usually 1–3 agents contact youAlgorithm; only agents who signed HomeLight's fee agreement are matched; criteria not published
Clever Real EstateNot publishedA concierge calls, then you interview 2–3+ agentsAgents who accept Clever's discounted listing rate
Zillow (Preferred / Premier Agent)Up to 40% reported, or pay-per-leadRouted to one partner agent by ZIPOpaque "performance-based routing"; invitation-only partners
RamseyTrustedNot publishedUp to 3 agents reach out to win your businessVetting claimed (50+ closings, top 10%); method not published
Redfin Partner Agents~30% reportedAssigned one partner agentAssigned by Redfin
UpNest~30% reported3–5 agents send sealed proposals within 24hAgents bid for you

Sources: company help pages and public reporting (Inman, The Close, Bankrate, Clever, CFPB/court filings), 2022–2026. "Reported" figures aren't published by the company. Lawsuit items are allegations. Corrections welcome — we'll update within 48 hours.
